video_title: Khaman Maluach Fan Fest Media Availability | 10-2-26

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on team chemistry and new player integration
quotes.excerpt: We got a couple new players, we getting better each and every day, installing our identity.
quotes.quote: It's been great so far. We got a couple new players, we getting better each and every day, installing our identity. So, we've been getting better, so it's been great so far.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach says the Suns are focused on installing their identity as they integrate new players into the rotation.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on roster competition and team-first mentality
quotes.excerpt: It's not guaranteed for any of us to start and it don't really matter.
quotes.quote: It's going great because we both getting each other better. It's not guaranteed for any of us to start and it don't really matter. It's whatever the team needs best. If the team needs me, we both going to be available.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach says the starting lineup is not guaranteed and he is focused on a team first mentality. It does not really matter who starts as long as the team gets what it needs.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on the development of the Suns' young core
quotes.excerpt: We have a nice young core, so it's been great to see everybody's development.
quotes.quote: It's just how we've gotten better from time to time, especially us the young guys, Rasheed, Kobe, C.J., and all of us coming back with the knowledge we had from last year. We have a nice young core, so it's been great to see everybody's development from last year to now.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach highlights the growth of the Suns young core including Rasheed, Kobe, and CJ as they build on the knowledge gained from last season.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on physical growth and strength training benefits
quotes.excerpt: My body has changed, credit to our strength and conditioning team.
quotes.quote: The game has slowed down a little bit for me. My body has changed, credit to our strength and conditioning team. Everything else that really got better this year for me is from the strength that I gained, so when I gained the strength, most of the stuff got easier.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach says the game has slowed down for him thanks to his physical development. He credits the strength and conditioning team for making the game easier this year.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on mentoring rookie teammate
quotes.excerpt: The other rookies who were there with me last year and me too, we got to help.
quotes.quote: Me and my rookie year was easier because I had Rasheed, I had Kobe, I had C.J., some guys who were going through the same thing as me. For the other rookie, it's different right now because he's the only rookie. The other rookies who were there with me last year and me too, we got to help. We all got to come together and help him through this.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach discusses the importance of the veteran young players helping the current rookie adjust to life in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on representing Africa in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's really good, really great to represent Africa that we have people from different countries.
quotes.quote: It's really good, really great to represent Africa that we have people from different countries in Africa or different continents in the NBA. A lot of us could come together and put Africa on the map, run some camps, or maybe we'll come together sometime and run regional camps in Africa so that we give the next generation opportunities just like how they did to us.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach discusses his desire to represent Africa and potentially run regional camps to provide opportunities for the next generation of players.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on his transition to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The Suns really welcomed me when I came here as an 18-year-old.
quotes.quote: It's been great for me. The Suns really welcomed me when I came here as an 18-year-old. They welcomed me and they believe in me, and they're trusting the process with me, so it's been great.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach reflects on his transition to the NBA, noting that the Suns have trusted the process with him since he arrived as an 18 year old.
